Biography

Born for the Stage

Soprano Etīna Emīlija Saulīte (born 2005, Latvia) is one of the most exceptional young voices to have emerged from the Baltic region in recent years — a singer whose rapid international trajectory has already taken her from Riga to Teatro alla Scala, Budapest, and Berlin before the age of twenty-one.

She completed her diploma in music theory, classical vocal, and history at the NMV Emīla Dārziņa Music School in Riga (2022–2025), studying voice under Irma Pavāre. Her development was further shaped by private coaching from Marek Rzepka, Edgars Kramiņš, Irina Gavrilovici, and Irma Pavāre.

From September 2023 to June 2025, she was a member of the Latvian National Opera choir, during which time she began performing as a soloist in major concerts. In April 2025 she made her role debut as Liù in Puccini's Turandot at the LNO — an engagement running through January 2026.

In June 2025 she completed the Georg Solti Accademia in Italy, and was invited to perform at the prestigious Solti Gala with Rising Stars at the Hungarian State Opera in Budapest on 19 October 2025 — singing arias from La Bohème and La Traviata alongside an international ensemble of eight singers.

In October 2025 she was accepted into the Accademia Teatro alla Scala (Oct 2025–Jun 2027), one of the world's most selective opera training programmes. Her debut at Teatro alla Scala followed in December 2025, in the title role of Sebastiano Colasanti's Anna A. — an Accademia production on the main stage of La Scala.

Her parallel concert career encompasses recurring projects including Debisī. Ir jāpiedzīvo, a concert-story performed across multiple cities with pianist Daniil Mickevich (Riga, Rēzekne, Valmiera, 2024–25), and concerts for the Pēteris Vasks Foundation at Mežotne and the Spīķeri Concert Hall. She has been featured in broadcasts on Latvian Radio 3 / Klasika.

Featured Project — Archive & Recordings
Concert-Story · Recurring Project · 2024–25
DEBISĪ. Ir jāpiedzīvo
A concert-story by soprano Etīna Emīlija Saulīte, pianist Daniils Mickevičs, and actor Artis Jančevskis. Tracing the life of Claude Debussy through his vocal miniatures, piano works, and letters. Premiered at the Great Guild, Riga (Jun 2024), performed at Spīķeri Concert Hall, Rēzekne, Valmiera, Daugavpils, and further venues through 2025.

Performance · Pēteris Vasks Foundation · Aug 2025
Pēteris Vasks ielūdz. Vasara. Mežotne
14th annual summer concert of the Pēteris Vasks Foundation at Mazā Mežotnes pils. Programme included world premieres of works by Georgijs Pelēcis and Oskars Herliņš, alongside songs by Arvīds Žilinsks, Romuaolds Kalsons, and Andris Dzenītis. Performed with pianist Rihards Plešanovs, Amanda Tauriņa (cor anglais), and Matīss Eisaks (double bass). Received standing ovations.

Artist Management · Munich, Germany

Etīna Emīlija Saulīte is represented by Artista International, a Munich-based management specialising in opera, concert, and Lied. The agency manages a select international roster and handles all professional bookings, contract negotiations, and career planning.

Latvian National Opera & Ballet
Institutional Affiliation · Riga, Latvia

Etīna Emīlija Saulīte has been associated with the Latvian National Opera since 2023, first as a choir member and subsequently as a soloist. The LNO, founded in 1919, is the Baltic region's premier opera institution.
